content_md:
HowTo: *monitor my 3 Gmail's, 1 Outlook, and 2 Proton email accounts for actionable items*

Pain Point: *I just can't keep up. Would be nice if a robot would help me. Maybe I'd pay $5 to Just Do It For Me. Imagine \$x x N users = \$quadrillion\$\$\$ in TAM via productivity gains unlocked by AI*

### American Approach 1 - Apple Mail

- always there, syncs seamlessly across devices
- better than good enough privacy, as Mossad appears to try other approaches rather than hacking it directly
- don't sell actual AI solutions, sell Mac Mini's!

### Global Tech Approach 2 - OpenClaw

- give it all the signins and skills. yolo
- chat with it. maybe get a funny story, like that woman who works for Meta AI who shouted STOP in Telegram then sprinted over to unplug her Mac Mini. Good times

### Chinese Approach 3 - Claude Code + general IMAP MCP

- written fast and lean by some Chinese guy
- handles everything
- 1000 stars on Github, enough to get recommended by LLMs

### Turkish Approach 4 - Claude Code + specialized MCPs for each provider

- maybe 19 stars each
